description: LLM emulator set for the HarlotsEight_Vol1_SM.docx PictureBook chapter-handling run. Non-strict: any request without an exact-key recording is answered by the deterministic synthesizer, whose first extracted scene title begins with the first non-blank line of the chunk text so a Ux test can prove which chapter text reached the prompt. Recordings are the <sha256>.json entries of fixtures.zip in this directory (real goekdenizguelmez/JOSIEFIED-Qwen3:8b completions captured through pictureBookChapteredManuscriptUx.spec.js; re-recorded 2026-11-13 against Ollama at 192.168.1.42 direct after the §24 #3 chunk-budget change: 536 entries — chat 226, cluster-locations 20, extract-chunk 69, extract-scenes 1, guess-apparel 69, reduce-character 151 — all 21 chapters recorded with no gaps). Two kinds embed series-wide state read at call time and are expected to miss in replay: cluster-locations carries the world's known-locations list, and chat (pictureBook.compose-scene) carries each cast member's pbDescription, which for a shared series character is the first of several per-chapter attribute rows in an order that depends on how the 2-wide chapter jobs interleaved; the emulated spec pins those two by pipeline shape and every chapter-local kind to zero synth. A loose <sha256>.json recorder drop (LLM_EMULATOR_RECORD_DIR/<model>/<sha256>.json) placed here overrides a same-named zip entry and is git-ignored. recordingGaps declares where the recording run itself lost chunks (chapter 1-based, fromChunk 0-based): from that chunk to the end of the chapter the emulator necessarily synthesizes, because each chunk's prompt carries the previous chunk's scenes; the emulated spec exempts those scenes from the recorded-title check and pins the synth count to exactly that range.
